title: 为 previous_window 增加倒序窗口显式 ValueError（run2）

report.summary:
Done: PR #12 (https://github.com/paxxie2/b5-off-site-pnl/pull/12) adds the explicit reversed-window ValueError in backend/app/domain/money.py. A person must merge (no auto-merge configured).

## Change
`previous_window(start, end)` raises `ValueError` when the parsed `start > end`, with a message naming both bounds; the docstring documents the contract. `date_range`, all other functions, signatures and dependencies are untouched. Diff: 7 insertions, 1 deletion, only `backend/app/domain/money.py` (allowed scope).

## Verification actually run
- Stdlib-only acceptance mirror, run from outside the repository (`/tmp/pw-mirror`): 7 legal windows (single-day, same-month, cross-month, non-leap Feb, leap Feb 2028, cross-year, leap-day boundary) with expectations independently recomputed via `datetime` arithmetic, plus 4 reversed windows (day/month/year/leap-day boundaries). Legal assertions pass on both revisions. Baseline commit `1e166fb` fails 3/3 runs with `AssertionError: DID NOT RAISE ValueError for reversed window ...` (target assertion failure, not import/dependency failure). Patched head passes 3/3 runs.
- `uv run --offline pytest backend/tests/test_money.py backend/tests/test_pnl.py backend/tests/test_rules.py backend/tests/test_scenarios.py -q`: 49 passed.
- Self-review: diff limited to money.py; commit author paxxie2; working tree clean; PR mergeable; no CI checks configured.
- Pre-existing limitation (unrelated, outside allowed scope): full `backend/tests` cannot collect `test_db.py` / `test_seed.py` and DB-backed fixtures because `backend/app/data` is absent at baseline (`data/` gitignored) → `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'app.data'`.

## Risks / notes
- No human review requested or received; repository has no review rules/CI. Human must merge.
- Duplicate: open PRs #3, #6, #8, #10 (issues #2/#5/#7/#9) propose the identical change from prior independent runs; the fix is not yet on `main`. Only one should merge.
- No reviewer credit needed (no human reviews on this PR). No auto-merge enabled, per rules.
